text.text: Choose a zone to highlight it. Read the observation, then compare the cutaway and pore view.
Air and water share pore space
Look for: Find water beside air between the solid grains. Unsaturated does not mean completely dry.
Dashed line: schematic water table. The thin band above it represents the capillary fringe.
Some spaces contain air; others hold liquid water or water films.
Magnified schematic of an unconfined groundwater setting. Grain sizes, layer depths and arrows are illustrative. This view does not measure recharge, water-table depth or travel time.
